description: Header file defining the V4L2JpegEncodeAccelerator class for hardware-accelerated JPEG encoding using V4L2 in Chromium's media GPU component. It declares classes, methods, and data structures related to JPEG encoding acceleration, buffer management, and device interaction.

classes.name: V4L2JpegEncodeAccelerator
classes.description: Main class providing hardware-accelerated JPEG encoding via V4L2, managing buffers, device interaction, and encoding jobs.

classes.name: EncodedInstance
classes.description: Handles a specific set of JPEG encoding parameters, manages V4L2 buffers, JPEG marker preparation, and encoding process.

classes.name: EncodedInstanceDmaBuf
classes.description: Handles JPEG encoding with DMA buffers, managing buffer creation, JPEG parameter setup, and encoding.

classes.name: JobRecord
classes.description: Represents a JPEG encoding job, including input/output frames, quality, task ID, and shared memory mappings.

classes.name: JpegBufferRecord
classes.description: Represents a buffer for JPEG output, including memory address, length, and device access status.

classes.name: I420BufferRecord
classes.description: Represents a buffer for I420 input, including memory address, length, and device access status.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the encoder asynchronously with a client callback.

methods.name: GetMaxCodedBufferSize
methods.description: Returns maximum buffer size for a given picture size.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes a VideoFrame with specified quality, outputting JPEG data.

methods.name: EncodeWithDmaBuf
methods.description: Encodes a VideoFrame using DMA buffers with specified quality and task ID.

methods.name: VideoFrameReady
methods.description: Callback when a frame has been encoded.

methods.name: NotifyError
methods.description: Notifies about an error during encoding.
